response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), status_shares AS (SELECT powerstatus, telescope_count, 100.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share_pct FROM status_counts), above_average AS (SELECT telescope_count, share_pct, AVG(share_pct) OVER () AS average_share_pct FROM status_shares WHERE share_pct > (SELECT AVG(share_pct) FROM status_shares)) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count, AVG(share_pct) AS average_share_pct, AVG(share_pct - average_share_pct) AS average_amount_above_average_share_pct FROM above_average;
